verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Stripe CLI documented at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli. The Financial Connections use-cases page also lists a "Link CLI" for agent-powered financial insights such as spending analysis and balance and transaction monitoring, which points to official CLI tooling for AI-native workflows on this product. missing for 10: in-depth evidence of which Financial Connections operations the CLI covers, documentation of Link CLI commands and setup, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use with Financial Connections.
